description: Filament 5 admin panel at /admin (App\Infrastructure\Providers\Filament\AdminPanelProvider; resources, pages and widgets are discovered from app/Infrastructure/Filament). Access is granted to users with the boolean users.is_admin column: create a user with `php artisan make:filament-user`, then run `php artisan admin:promote <email>`. Overwrites bootstrap/providers.php with the full list (AppServiceProvider + AdminPanelProvider): the LAST layer of a variant owns that list. Not used with laravel/lunar (Lunar 1.x pulls Filament 4 and owns its own panel).
